== Why the long footnote WRT membership in CoA ==

I searched all 14 books twice for references to Canvele and found only four in the prologue to ACOS. In none of those references is Canvele direcly identified as a member of the Council.  However, it is highly likely that, with he being held in such high, ah, regard (probably not the best word but it will do for now) by Asunawa and Valda--both considered him an essential supporter to the completion of their individual goals--he was probably a member.  "Probably" however, isn't a fact--it's indirect evidence, but it's not fact. So looking deeper into the text we find a little later in the prologue that all Lord Captains present in the Fortress are summoned to a meeting of the Council of the Anointed.  That includes Lord Captain Canvele (so called by Asunawa), and so with that action, it can be concluded that he is a member.   If this is too picky for you, come chat with me on my Talk page.[[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 00:14, May 21, 2012 (UTC)
